z-m-31-12.topic: Helidda celceliska guud adoo isticmaalaya wax-soo-saarka vector saf (saamiga ardayda) iyo matrix celcelis

z-m-31-12.material: Isla fasalka dugsi, waxaa jira Fasalka 1 iyo Fasalka 2. Celceliska maadada kasta fasal kasta waxaa lagu habeeyay jadwal. Fasalka 1: Af-Kuuriyaan 70, xisaab 80, Ingiriisi 60. Fasalka 2: Af-Kuuriyaan 80, xisaab 70, Ingiriisi 70. Sida matrix, M = ( 70 80 60 ; 80 70 70 ) (saf sare Fasalka 1, saf hoose Fasalka 2). Codsi ayaa yimid in la sheego celceliska maadooyinka fasalka oo dhan hal sadar. Jiwon wuxuu yiri, "Isku dar celceliska labada fasal oo u qaybi 2."

z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad ku dhegtay 0 ee A² oo keliya, mana tarjumin shaxda wadooyinka ee cusub ee la muujiyey.
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A iyo A² way is khilaafaan, sidaa darteed mid ka mid ah waa inuu leeyahay khalad xisaabeed oo waa in laga bilaabo dib loo xisaabiyo
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: A iyo A² waxay tiriyaan wax kala duwan (wadooyinka hal lug, wadooyinka laba lug), sidaa darteed xataa haddii qiimayaashu kala duwan yihiin, khilaaf ma aha.
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Waxaa jirta wado degdeg ah, sidaa darteed gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 2 ee A² sidoo kale waa inuusan ahayn eber, haddii uu yahay 0, xisaabinta A² waa khalad
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wado degdeg ah waa wado hal lug ah, A² na wuxuu tiriyaa wadooyin laba lug ah. Jiritaanka wado degdeg ah A² ma weyneeyo.
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Waxaa jirta wado degdeg ah, sidaa darteed gunaanadka Seoa waa khalad. 0 ee A² macnaheedu waa wado laba lug ah ma jirto oo keliya
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Markan waa laga bilaabo 3 ilaa 2. Gelitaanka safka 3, tiirka 2 ee A waa 0, gelitaanka safka 3, tiirka 2 ee A² na sidoo kale waa 0 (safka 3 ee A² waa 1 0 0 0).
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Laga bilaabo 3 ilaa 2, ma tegi kartid hal lug ama saxda laba lug. Maxaad halkan ka odhan kartaa?
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Gelitaanka safka 3, tiirka 2 ee A³ waa 1 (3→4→1→2, saddex lug). Xataa haddii hal ama laba lug la xidho, waad ka tegi kartaa saddex lug. Labadaba xukunka dib u dhigidda iyo hubinta, iyo xukunka dejinta kala duwanaanshaha lagu hubinayo tirada joogsiyada, waa macquul.
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Waxaan ku gunaanan karnaa 'ma tegi kartid.' Labada xaaladood ee suurtagalka ah waa xidhan yihiin
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Weli ma isku dayin inaad sii kordhiso tirada lugaha. Marka ay jiraan 4 joogsi, waa maxay xadka tirada lugaha aad u baahan tahay inaad hubiso?
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Waxaan odhan karnaa kaliya ma tegi kartid hal ama laba lug. Wadooyin dheer waa in lagu hubiyo raacidda khariidadda wadada ama awoodaha sare ee A
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Waxaa jira 4 joogsi, sidaa darteed wadooyinka aan mareynin isla joogsiga laba jeer waxay leeyihiin ugu badnaan 3 lug. Haddii aan hubino ilaa 3 lug, waxaa la go'aamiyaa haddii aad tegi kartid
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Haddii ay jirto wado dheer lagu hubin karo habab maya
z-m-31-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Waxaa jira habab loo hubiyo. Waxaad kordhin kartaa tirada lugaha hal-hal oo eegi kartaa awoodaha, ama waxaad raaci kartaa khariidadda wadada.
z-m-31-01.s.s1.reflect: Xukunkee ayaad bilowgii gaartay, oo sidee ayuu xukunkaagii iyo heerka kalsoonidaadu u beddelmeen ka dib aragtida A iyo xogta 3→2? Hal weedh ku sheeg qiimaha '0' waa eber waxa.
z-m-31-01.s.s2.prompt: Si aad isla markiiba u ogaato haddii aad ka tegi kartid joogsiga 1 ilaa joogsiga 2 'hal lug ama laba lug,' ma way ku filan tahay in la eego haddii gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 2 ee matrix-ka kee ka weyn yahay 0? Dooro dhammaan kuwa saxda ah.
z-m-31-01.s.s2.hint.0: Si toos ah u hel gelitaannada. Waxaad u baahan tahay gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 2 oo keliya, sidaa darteed marka hore qor qiimayaasha gelitaannada safka 1, tiirka 2 ee A iyo A².
z-m-31-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qor matrix-yada wadarku noqdo marka (E + A)² la fidiyo ku dhufasho, oo eeg intee le'eg ayuu E gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 2 ku darayaa.
z-m-31-01.s.s2.r.a: Wuxuu tiriyaa kaliya wadooyin saxda laba lug ah, sidaa darteed wuxuu seegaa wadooyin degdeg ah. 1→2 ee hawshan waa xaalad sidaas ah saxda.
z-m-31-01.s.s2.r.b: Waa wadarka tirada wadooyinka hal lug ah iyo tirada wadooyinka laba lug ah. Haddii gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 2 uu ka weyn yahay 0, waad tegi kartaa hal lug ama laba lug.
z-m-31-01.s.s2.r.c: Wuxuu tiriyaa kaliya wadooyin saxda saddex lug ah, sidaa darteed ku habboon ma aha su'aashan.
z-m-31-01.s.s2.r.d: Wuxuu fidaa E + 2A + A². Gelitaannada i≠j, E waa 0, sidaa darteed gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 2 oo ka weyn 0 waxay la mid tahay mid ka mid ah A ama A² oo ka weyn 0.
z-m-31-01.s.s2.explain: Labadaba A + A² iyo (E + A)² waxay isla ka tarjumaan 'tirada wadooyinka hal lug ah' iyo 'tirada wadooyinka laba lug ah' gelitaannada i≠j. A² ama A³ keligiis wuxuu go'aamiyaa tirada lugaha. (E wuxuu tiriyaa joogitaanka meel, sidaa darteed gelitaannada i=j si gooni ah ayaa loo akhriyaa.)
z-m-31-01.s.s3.prompt: Walaalka yar ayaa yiri, "Haddii gelitaan A² uu yahay 0, macnaheedu waa ma tegi kartid." U sharax walaalka, adigoo tirooyin joogsi isticmaalaya, waxa sax ah iyo waxa khaldan ee hadalkan.
z-m-31-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore qor wadooyinka tirada lugaha kee ayuu hadalka Seoa sax u yahay.
z-m-31-01.s.s3.hint.1: Dooro 1→2 ama 3→2, oo sharax adigoo tirooyin ku qoraya imisa lug ayay wadadaasi leedahay.
z-m-31-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxaaddayda waxay ka kooban tahay 'wadooyinka noocee ah ayuu A² tiriyo'?
z-m-31-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxaaddayda waxay caddeyneysaa ilaa tirada lugaha kee la hubiyo si loo yiraahdo 'ma tegi kartid'?
z-m-31-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma tusaale gaar ah sida 1→2 ama 3→2 wuxuu taageeraa sharaxaaddayda?
z-m-31-01.s.s3.model.0: Gelitaannada A² waa tirooyinka wadooyinka leh saxda laba lug. Sidaa darteed xataa haddii gelitaanka laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 2 uu yahay 0, waad tegi kartaa haddii ay jirto wado degdeg ah. Hadalka ah haddii uu yahay 0 ma tegi kartid waa khalad.
z-m-31-01.s.s3.model.1: 0 wuxuu macnaheedu yahay ma tegi kartid laba lug oo keliya. Laga bilaabo 3 ilaa 2, xataa haddii labada A iyo A² ay yihiin 0, waad tegi kartaa saddex lug sida 3→4→1→2. Waa inaad hubisaa adigoo beddelaya tirada lugaha.

z-m-31-02.title: Helitaanka sadarka ka baxay xalka isla'egta matrix
z-m-31-02.topic: Isla'egta matrix AX=B iyo kala horreynta ku dhufashada rogan
z-m-31-02.goal: Xalka isla'egta matrix, hel oo sax sadarrada halka baabi'inta aan la caddayn, oo shuruudo ku sheeg waxa dhaca xalalka isla'egta marka matrix-ka isku-dhufashada uusan lahayn rogan.
z-m-31-02.material: Haram wuxuu rabaa inuu helo matrix 2×2 X isla'egta matrix AX = B. A = ( 2 1 ; 1 1 ), B = ( 4 1 ; 3 2 ) (semicolon ka hor waa safka sare, ka dib na waa safka hoose). A⁻¹ waxaa loo akhriyaa 'rogan A.' Xalka Haram waa kan hoose.
z-m-31-02.thinking.0: Hubinta sadar kasta oo xalka ah si loo helo khaladka ugu horreeya
z-m-31-02.thinking.2: Xukunka gunaanadka xaaladda aan lahayn rogan adigoo u kala qaybinaya iyadoo loo eegayo B
z-m-31-02.prereq.0: H3 ee hawshani waa adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada qorshahan wax-soo-saarka oo keliya, macnaheedu na maaha in manhajku nuxurkan ku meelaynayo sannad gaar ah. Waxaan u malaynaynaa in ku dhufashada matrix 2×2, kala-soocayaasha, iyo matrix-yada rogan (jira marka ad−bc≠0) la tababaray.
z-m-31-02.prereq.1: Waad ogtahay in wax-soo-saarka matrix-yada uu is beddeli karo marka kala horreynta la isweydaarsiiyo.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro sadarka xalka Haram halka wax khaldan marka hore ka muuqdaan. Sadarrada laga tiri 1.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar kasta, qor xeerkee (ku dhufashada labada dhinac, AA⁻¹ = E, iwm.) ayuu uga yimid sadarka ka horreeya, oo hubi haddii shuruudaha isticmaalka xeerkaas la buuxiyey.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.hint.1: Geli natiijada X ee sadarka 5 AX = B, si toos ah u dhufo, oo hubi haddii ay la simanyahay B.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.line.0: Kala-soocaha A waa 2·1 − 1·1 = 1, sidaa darteed A wuxuu leeyahay rogan.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.line.2: Ku dhufashada A⁻¹ midigta labada dhinac ee AX = B waxay siinaysaa AXA⁻¹ = BA⁻¹.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.line.3: AA⁻¹ = E, sidaa darteed AXA⁻¹ A iyo A⁻¹ way baaba'aan oo X = BA⁻¹.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.explain: Isla'egta sadarka 3 waa run sababtoo ah isla matrix ayaa lagu dhufay isla dhinaca labada dhinac. Laakiin sadarka 4 waa khalad. AXA⁻¹, X wuxuu u dhexeeyaa A iyo A⁻¹, sidaa darteed labada matrix midba midka kale agtiisa ma jiraan. Ku dhufashada matrix lama dib u habayn karo, sidaa darteed ma isticmaali kartid AA⁻¹ = E. Xisaabinta laftooda sadarrada 1 ilaa 3 iyo sadarka 5 waa sax, laakiin X = ( 3 −2 ; 1 1 ) ee ka dhashay sadarka 4 ma buuxiso AX = B (AX = ( 7 −3 ; 4 −1 )). Haddii aad beddesho dhinaca aad ku dhufato, waxaad heshaa X = ( 1 −1 ; 2 3 ) AX = B na waa run.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.prompt: Haddii A uu yahay ( 1 2 ; 2 4 ), kala-soocaha waa 1·4 − 2·2 = 0, sidaa darteed rogan ma laha. Xaaladdan, dooro dhammaan B ee ay jirto matrix 2×2 X oo buuxisa AX = B.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.hint.0: Si toos ah u dhufo AX oo qor safka sare iyo safka hoose sida tibaax ku saabsan gelitaannada X (x₁ x₂ ; x₃ x₄).
z-m-31-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hel xiriirka had iyo jeer ka dhex jira safka sare iyo safka hoose, oo xiriirkaas ku tijaabi B kasta.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.a: Haddii AX = E, X waa inuu noqdaa rogan A, laakiin A rogan ma laha. Waxaad seegtay in B-gan uu la mid yahay dhibaatada rogan A.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.b: Kani waa B halka safka hoose uu yahay 2 jeer safka sare. Safka hoose ee AX had iyo jeer waa 2 jeer safka sare, sidaa darteed xal ayaa jira.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.c: Waad ogtahay in B jira oo xal leh xataa rogan la'aan, laakiin waxaad dooratay adigoon hubin xiriirka labada safka ee B. Safka hoose (3 4) maaha 2 jeer safka sare (1 2).
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.d: Haddii aad sidoo kale X ka dhigto matrix eber, AX = B waa run. Rogan la'aanteed macnaheedu maaha 'xal ma jiro.'
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.e: Safka hoose waa 2 jeer safka sare, sidaa darteed xal ayaa jira. Tusaale ahaan, X = ( 2 2 ; 0 0 ).
z-m-31-02.s.s2.explain: A = ( 1 2 ; 2 4 ), safka sare ee AX waa 'safka sare ee X ku dar 2 jeer safka hoose ee X' safka hoose na waa 2 jeer taas. Sidaa darteed xal ayaa jira kaliya marka safka hoose ee B uu yahay 2 jeer safka sare. Rogan la'aanteed macnaheedu maaha 'xal ma jiro B kasta' laakiin 'iyadoo ku xidhan B, xal waa jiri karaa ama ma jiri karo.'
z-m-31-02.s.s3.prompt: Saaxiib ayaa yiri, "Haddii A rogan aan lahayn, AX = B lama xalin karo." Ka jawaab xaaladdee ayuu hadalkani khalad yahay, adigoo ku daraya hal tusaale.
z-m-31-02.s.s3.hint.0: A aan lahayn rogan, dooro B aad u fudud (tusaale ahaan, mid gelitaannadiisa dhammaantood yihiin 0) oo hubi haddii ay jirto X buuxisa AX = B.
z-m-31-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tusaalaha aad heshay, sharax adigoo qoraya haddii dhufashada AX si toos ah ay siinayso B.
z-m-31-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxaaddayda waxay kala saartaa 'weligeed lama xalin karo' iyo 'waxaa jira xaalado lagu xalin karo'?
z-m-31-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma hubisay adigoo si toos ah u dhufanaya in tusaalaha aan bixiyey runtii buuxiyo AX = B?
z-m-31-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegay astaanta B-yada xal leh (xiriirka u dhexeeya labada saf)?
z-m-31-02.s.s3.model.0: Maya. Xataa matrix rogan la'aan, xal ayaa jiri kara iyadoo ku xiran B. Tusaale ahaan, haddii B uu yahay matrix eber, X oo la qaado matrix eber ayaa ka dhigaysa AX = B.
z-m-31-02.s.s3.model.1: Waxaa jira xaalado xal leh sidoo kale. Haddii B uu yahay ( 3 5 ; 6 10 ), kaas oo safka hoose yahay 2 jeer safka sare, waxaa lagu xallinayaa X = ( 3 5 ; 0 0 ). Sidaas darteed run ma aha in aan weligeed la xallin karin sababtoo ah matrix rogan ma leh.

z-m-31-03.title: Helidda xeerka mashiin ee diiwaannada gelinta iyo soo-saarka
z-m-31-03.topic: Helidda xubnaha matrix 2×2 oo dhaqaajiya dhibco (ku-filnaanta macluumaadka)
z-m-31-03.goal: Marka diiwaannada gelinta-soo-saarka ay hal sadar mar kordhaan, go'aami ilaa xubnaha matrix 2×2 kuwee ayaa la go'aamiyay, oo adigu hel shuruudda gelinta ee waxtarka u leh helidda matrix gabi ahaanba.
z-m-31-03.material: Waxaa jira mashiin u daawada dhibic (x, y) sidii matrix tiir oo ku dhufta matrix 2×2 M = ( a b ; c d ) oo leh xubno joogto ah si ay u dhaqaajiso dhibic cusub ( ax+by , cx+dy ). Ka hor semicolon waa safka sare ka dib-na waa safka hoose. Ma ognin qiyamka a, b, c, d, laakiin haddii aan dhibic geliyo, waxaan heli karnaa soo-saar sax ah. Aan aragno waxa aan ka baran karno M marka diiwaannada hal sadar mar lagu daro.
z-m-31-03.thinking.0: Kala saarista waxa lagu go'aamiyay macluumaadka aad haysato iyo waxa aadan weli ogeyn
z-m-31-03.thinking.1: Kala saarista haddii diiwaan cusub yahay macluumaad cusub
z-m-31-03.prereq.0: H3 ee hawshan waa adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada qorshahan soo saarista oo keliya, macnaheeduna ma aha in manhajku waxyaabahan fasalkaas u qoondeeyo. Waxaan malaynaynaa inaad ku layli gashay ku dhufashada matrix 2×2 iyo matrix tiir 2×1 iyo dhaqaajinta dhibic (x, y) adigoo matrix isticmaalaya (soo-saar = ( ax+by , cx+dy )).
z-m-31-03.prereq.1: Khibradda isla'egyada isku-xiran, waad ogtahay qiyaastii imisa isla'eg ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo helo 4 wax aan la aqoon.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.prompt: Diiwaannada waxaa la muujiyaa hal sadar mar kasta. Mar kasta, dooro inta aad ka ogaan karto M.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.hint.0: Geli labada xubnood ee gelinta si toos ah ax+by iyo cx+dy, oo qor xarfaha kuwee ayaa ku hadha tibaaxaha.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.hint.1: Is barbar dhig tibaaxaha diiwaanka cusub iyo qiyamka horeyba la helay, oo calaamadee haddii xaraf cusub la go'aamiyay.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Marka gelinta (1, 0) la geliyay, soo-saarku wuxuu ahaa (2, 3).
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Intee in le'eg ayaad hadda ka ogaan kartaa M?
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Haddii aad geliso (1, 0), soo-saarku waa ( a·1+b·0 , c·1+d·0 ) = ( a , c ). Waxaad ogaan kartaa tiirka koowaad waa (2, 3), laakiin b iyo d weli ma ka muuqan isla'eg.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waxaad heli kartaa dhammaan afarta xubnood a, b, c, d
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaa jira 4 wax aan la aqoon laakiin 2 isla'eg oo keliya ayaa la helay. Ka fikir xubnaha la go'aamiyay.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hal gelin ma ku sheegi karto wax M ah
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Soo-saarku lafteedu waa macluumaad. Haddii aad geliso (1, 0), soo-saarku waa qiyamka ax+by iyo cx+dy iyadoo 1 iyo 0 loo geliyay x iyo y.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Safka sare waa (2, 3), sidaas darteed a = 2 iyo b = 3
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad u akhridday labada xubnood ee soo-saarka sidii xubnaha hal saf. Soo-saarku waa qiyamka ax+by iyo cx+dy ee si gooni ah loo xisaabiyay iyadoo 1 iyo 0 loo geliyay x iyo y.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Tiirka koowaad oo keliya ayaa la ogaan karaa tiirka labaadna weli lama yaqaan
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Marka gelinta (2, 0) la geliyay, soo-saarku wuxuu ahaa (4, 6).
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Maxay diiwaankani si cusub uga sheegay M?
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Haddii aad geliso (2, 0), ( 2a , 2c ) = (4, 6), taasoo mar kale kaliya sheegaysa in a = 2 iyo c = 3. Gelintu waa 2 jeer (1, 0), sidaas darteed macluumaad cusub ma jiro ku dhawaad.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Wuxuu kaliya mar kale xaqiijiyaa tiirka koowaad, tiirka labaadna weli lama yaqaan
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Tiirka labaad (b, d) hadda sidoo kale waa la ogaan karaa
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Haddii xubinta labaad ee gelintu tahay 0, b iyo d lagu dhufan tibaaxaha.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Waxaad ogaan kartaa M inay tahay mashiin labanlaabaya gelinta
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Soo-saarka (4, 6) waa 2 jeer soo-saarkii hore (2, 3). Ka fikir haddii ay tahay natiijo ka timid gelinta oo labanlaabantay.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Soo-saarku ma ku habboona, sidaas darteed mashiinkan lagama matali karo matrix
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Haddii aad geliso gelinta (2, 0), soo-saarku waa inuu soo baxaa 2 jeer tiirka koowaad. Ma ka soo horjeedo diiwaankii hore.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Marka gelinta (1, 1) la geliyay, soo-saarku wuxuu ahaa (3, 4).
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hadda ma ogaan kartaa M oo dhan? Haddii aad ogaan kartid, waa maxay M?
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Soo-saarka (1, 1) waa ( a + b , c + d ) = (3, 4), maadaama a = 2 iyo c = 3-na, b = 1 iyo d = 1. M = ( 2 1 ; 3 1 ), wuxuuna ku habboon yahay dhammaan saddexda diiwaan.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Weli ma ogaan kartid. Hal gelin oo dheeraad ah ayaa loo baahan yahay
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Marka a + b = 3 iyo c + d = 4, a = 2 iyo c = 3 horeyba way jiraan, sidaas darteed b iyo d waa la go'aamiyay. Isku day inaad samayso isla'egyo dheeraad ah.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tani waa natiijo ka timid akhrinta tiirka koowaad (2, 3) sidii safka koowaad. Mar kale eeg jihada tiirarka iyo safafka.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Gudaha c + d = 4, marka la helayo d waxay u egtahay inaadan ka jarin c = 3 oo aad isticmaashay qiime kale. Mar kale xalli isla'egta c + d = 4 ee safka hoose.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.reflect: Sidee u kala duwanaatay macluumaadka aad heshay marka la geliyo diiwaanka labaad iyo diiwaanka saddexaad? Xataa tirada diiwaannada isku mid ah, sheeg gelinta kee ayaa waxtar badan lahayd.

z-m-31-05.title: Kharashka labada kala horreyn ee ku dhufashada saddex matrix
z-m-31-05.topic: Kala horreynta kooxeynta iyo tirada ku dhufashooyinka wax-soo-saarka saddex matrix
z-m-31-05.goal: Ku hubi xisaab in wax-soo-saarka saddex matrix ABC natiijadu aysan ku xirnayn kala horreynta kooxeynta laakiin tirada ku dhufashooyinka ay aad u kala duwanaan karto iyadoo ku xiran cabbirrada, oo naqshadee cabbirro dhinac ka door bida adigu.
z-m-31-05.material: Matrix A waa p×q, B waa q×r, C-na waa r×s. Wax-soo-saarka ABC wuxuu bixiyaa isla natiijo haddii loo xisaabiyo (AB)C ama A(BC) (sharciga isku-xirka). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, si loo xisaabiyo (m×n)·(n×k), waxaad samaysaa m·n·k ku dhufashooyin xubno, sidaas darteed wadarta tirada ku dhufashooyinka waxay ku kala duwanaan kartaa iyadoo ku xiran lammaanaha aad marka hore ku dhufato. Ku darista lama tirinayo. Tusaale ahaan, A waa 4×2, B waa 2×30, C-na waa 30×1.
z-m-31-05.thinking.0: Kala saarista in xataa isla natiijada, kharashka geeddi-socodka uu kala duwanaan karo

z-m-31-05.thinking.2: Dhisidda xeer khibrad ahaan dhinaca la doorbido shuruudo kuwee, adigoo ka warqabaya suurtagalnimada tusaalayaal lid ku ah

Waxaan malaynaynaa inaad ogtahay shuruudda cabbirka ee ku dhufashada matrix ay suurtagal tahay ((m×n)·(n×k) → m×k) iyo sharciga isku-xirka ku dhufashada (AB)C = A(BC).
z-m-31-05.prereq.1: Waxaan aqbalaynaa sidii heshiis ee hawshan in xisaabinta (m×n)·(n×k) ay qaadanayso m·n·k ku dhufashooyin xubno.
z-m-31-05.s.s1.prompt: Marka A, B, iyo C ee tusaalaha kore la ku dhufto laba kala horreyn, dooro hadalka saxda ah ee ku saabsan natiijada iyo tirada ku dhufashooyinka.
z-m-31-05.s.s1.hint.0: Labada hab mid walba, qor imisa saf iyo tiir ayuu leeyahay matrix-ka natiijada ee wax-soo-saarka koowaad.
z-m-31-05.s.s1.hint.1: Qor tirada ku dhufashooyinka tallaabo kasta sida m·n·k mid mid oo tallaabo tallaabo isku dar.

z-m-31-05.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u fidisay xaqiiqda ah in sharciga isku-xirku dammaanad qaado 'natiijooyinku waa isku mid' oo keliya tirooyinka sidoo kale. Si toos ah u tiri tirada ku dhufashooyinka tallaabo kasta sida m·n·k.
z-m-31-05.s.s1.o.b: Natiijooyinku waa isku mid, laakiin (AB)C wuxuu u baahan yahay ku dhufashooyin ka yar A(BC)
z-m-31-05.s.s1.r.b: AB waa matrix 4×30, sidaas darteed natiijada dhexe waa weyn tahay. Si toos ah isku dar tirooyinka tallaabo kasta.
z-m-31-05.s.s1.o.c: Natiijooyinku way kala duwan yihiin tirada ku dhufashooyinkuna waa kala duwan
z-m-31-05.s.s1.r.c: Sharciga isku-xirku wuxuu leeyahay natiijada wax-soo-saarka ma ku xirna sida loo kooxeeyo. Haddii shuruudaha cabbirka la buuxiyo, natiijooyinku waa isku mid.
z-m-31-05.s.s1.o.d: Natiijooyinku waa isku mid, laakiin A(BC) wuxuu u baahan yahay ku dhufashooyin ka yar (AB)C
z-m-31-05.s.s1.explain: (AB)C wuxuu qaadanayaa 4·2·30 = 240 AB 4·30·1 = 120 (AB)C, 360 wadar ahaan. A(BC) wuxuu qaadanayaa 2·30·1 = 60 BC 4·2·1 = 8 A(BC), 68 wadar ahaan. Natiijooyinku waa isku mid, laakiin tirooyinku aad bay u kala duwan yihiin.

z-m-31-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qor A(BC) si la mid ah oo is barbar dhig labada wadar.
z-m-31-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Xisaabtayda, ma u kala qaybisay tirinta hab kasta laba tallaabo oo ku darteen?
z-m-31-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma tijaabiyay xeerka aan qiyaasay cabbir kale hal mar si aan u hubiyo in tusaale lid ku ah uusan jirin?
z-m-31-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ma qortay anigoo kala saaraya 'had iyo jeer sidaas ayay tahay' iyo 'tusaalahayga sidaas ayay ahayd'?

Laakiin haddii cabbirradu isbeddelaan, waxay noqon kartaa ka soo horjeedda, sidaas darteed waa inaan ku hubiyaa tibaaxo.

z-m-31-06.title: Intee ayay isku eg yihiin matricesyada oo wadaaga laba lambar oo keliya?
z-m-31-06.topic: Raadiyaha iyo go'aamiyaha matrix 2×2 iyo A²−(a+d)A+(ad−bc)E
z-m-31-06.goal: Adigu samee matrix-yo kala duwan oo leh isla raadiye iyo go'aamiye, oo sharax sababta indha-indheynta ah inay buuxinayaan odhaah guud ay tahay in lagu xaqiijiyo furid xarfo ah ee ma aha tusaalayaal.
z-m-31-06.material: Matrix 2×2 A = ( a b ; c d ) ah, a + d waxaa loo yaqaan raadiye ad − bc-na waxaa loo yaqaan go'aamiye (ka hor semicolon-ka waa safka sare, ka dib-na waa safka hoose). E waa matrix-ka aqoonsiga O-na waa matrix-ka eber. Aan eegno matrix-yada raadiyahoodu yahay 5 go'aamiyahoodu-na yahay 6.
z-m-31-06.thinking.0: Samaynta tusaalayaal kala duwan oo buuxinaya shuruud
z-m-31-06.thinking.1: Kala saarista isla xeer in uu dhaco dhowr tusaale iyo caddayn guud
z-m-31-06.thinking.2: Hubinta hal sadar oo caddayn ah si loo helo khaladka
z-m-31-06.prereq.0: H3 ee hawshan waa adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada qorshahan soo saarka ah oo keliya, mana ay macnaheedu yahay in manhajku nuxurkan u qoondeeyo fasalkaas. Waxaan u qaadanaynaa inaad taqaan isku-dhufashada matrix 2×2 iyo xisaabta gelitaannada, wadarta iyo isku-dhufashooyinka tirada ee matrix-yada, go'aamiyaha ad−bc, iyo raadiyaha a+d.
z-m-31-06.prereq.1: Waad fur karaa oo fududayn kartaa odhaahyo ka kooban xarfo.
z-m-31-06.s.s1.prompt: Samee saddex matrix oo kala duwan oo a, b, c, d dhammaantood yihiin tirooyin dhan, raadiyuhu yahay 5, go'aamiyuhu-na yahay 6.
z-m-31-06.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore dooro a, hel d shuruudda raadiyaha, oo xisaabi waxa bc ay tahay inay noqoto ad − bc = 6.
z-m-31-06.s.s1.hint.1: Marka qiimaha bc la go'aamiyo, tirooyinka dhan dhexdooda raadi lammaane b, c oo isku-dhufashadoodu tahay qiimahaas.
z-m-31-06.s.s1.ok.c1: Afarta gelitaan dhammaantood waa tirooyin dhan.
z-m-31-06.s.s1.fail.c1: Fadlan gelitaannada dhammaantood ka dhig tirooyin dhan.
z-m-31-06.s.s1.fail.c3: ad − bc ma aha 6. Kadib dooridda a iyo d, hel waxa bc ay tahay inay noqoto.
z-m-31-06.s.s1.explain: Tusaale ahaan, haddii a = 2 iyo d = 3, bc waa inay noqotaa 0, haddii a = 1 iyo d = 4-na, ad = 4 sidaas darteed bc waa inay noqotaa −2. Xitaa marka gelitaannadu aad u kala duwan yihiin, sida (2, 0, 0, 3) iyo (1, 2, −1, 4), labada shuruudood waxay noqon karaan isku mid.
z-m-31-06.s.s2.prompt: Matrix-yada kor lagu sameeyay u yeedh A. Marka A² − 5A + 6E la xisaabiyay mid kasta, dhammaantood waxay soo baxeen matrix-ka eber O. Waa maxay habka ugu habboon ee looga odhan karo tan 'matrix 2×2 kasta oo leh raadiye 5 iyo go'aamiye 6 wuxuu buuxiyaa odhaahdan'?
z-m-31-06.s.s2.hint.0: Barbar dhig sida matrix-yada aan tijaabiyay ay isaga kala duwanaayeen marka laga reebo shuruudaha ah raadiyuhu yahay 5 go'aamiyuhuna yahay 6.
z-m-31-06.s.s2.hint.1: Adigoo a, b, c, d ilaalinaya sida xarfo, qor hal gelitaan oo keliya ee A² oo isku day inaad aragto sida gelitaankaasi odhaahda ugu fududaanayo.
z-m-31-06.s.s2.o.a: A, b, c, d ilaali sida xarfo, gelitaan kasta oo odhaahda si toos ah u fur, oo hubi inuu noqonayo 0
z-m-31-06.s.s2.o.b: Tijaabi dhowr matrix oo aan tirooyin dhan ahayn sidoo kale, haddii dhammaantood ay siinayaan O, tiri wuxuu ku jiraa kiis kasta
z-m-31-06.s.s2.r.b: Waxaad kordhisay tirada tusaalayaasha, laakiin weli ma hubin kiisaska 'dhammaan'. Kiisas aan dhammaan oo leh gelitaanno dhab ah ayaa hadha.
z-m-31-06.s.s2.o.c: Odhaahdu saddexdaba waa sii jirtay, sidaas darteed waxaan odhan karnaa waxay sii jirtaa matrix kasta oo leh raadiye 5 iyo go'aamiye 6
z-m-31-06.s.s2.r.c: Saddex tusaale ma damaanad qaadi karaan sheegasho guud. Inaan helin tusaale ka soo horjeedda way ka duwan tahay inay ku jirto kiis kasta.
z-m-31-06.s.s2.o.d: Xisaabtu way adag tahay, sidaas darteed ka xukun inaan hubin karin haddii ay sii jirto
z-m-31-06.s.s2.r.d: Furidda xarfo waa hab suurtagal ah xitaa haddii ay dheer tahay. Waxaad ka daaleen hubinta sababtoo ah way adkeyd.
z-m-31-06.s.s2.explain: Hubinta dhowr tusaale waxay kordhisaa rumaysadka laakiin ma damaanad qaado 'kiisaska oo dhan'. Haddii aad furto xarfo oo aad muujiso in gelitaan kasta uu had iyo jeer noqdo 0, wuxuu ku jiraa kiis kasta. Run ahaan, odhaahdani waxay sii jirtaa sida A² − (a+d)A + (ad−bc)E = O matrix 2×2 kasta oo A ah.
z-m-31-06.s.s3.prompt: Kani waa xal arday qoray si uu u hubiyo adigoo furaya xarfo. Dooro sadarka ugu horreeya ee khaldan.
z-m-31-06.s.s3.hint.0: Marka la sameynayo gelitaanka safka 2, tiirka 1 ee isku-dhufashada AA, tilmaan tiirkee ayaa gelitaannada safka hoose lagu dhufanayaa.
z-m-31-06.s.s3.hint.1: Mar kale samee isku-dhufashada sadar kasta odhaahda AA, ( a b ; c d )( a b ; c d ), adigoo calaamadinaya safka iyo tiirka.
z-m-31-06.s.s3.line.0: Gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 1 ee A² = AA waa a·a + b·c = a² + bc.
z-m-31-06.s.s3.line.1: Gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 2 waa a·b + b·d = ab + bd.
z-m-31-06.s.s3.line.2: Gelitaanka safka 2, tiirka 1 waa c·a + d·b = ca + db.
z-m-31-06.s.s3.line.3: Gelitaanka safka 2, tiirka 2 waa c·b + d·d = bc + d².
z-m-31-06.s.s3.line.4: Gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 1 ee (a+d)A waa (a+d)a = a² + ad, sidaas darteed gelitaanka safka 1, tiirka 1 ee A² − (a+d)A + (ad−bc)E waa (a² + bc) − (a² + ad) + (ad − bc) = 0.
z-m-31-06.s.s3.explain: Sadarka 3 waa khalad. Gelitaanka safka 2, tiirka 1 waa inuu ku dhufto safka hoose (c, d) tiirka koowaad (a, c), sidaas darteed waa c·a + d·c = ca + dc. d·b wuxuu ku dhufay gelitaanka b ee tiirka labaad, ma aha tiirka koowaad. Si sax ah loo qoray, gelitaanka safka 2, tiirka 1 waa ca + dc, ka jarista gelitaanka safka 2, tiirka 1 ee (a+d)A, (a+d)c = ac + dc, waxay siinaysaa 0.

z-m-31-09.title: Haddii AB uu yahay matrix aqoonsi, ma B waa rogan A?
z-m-31-09.topic: Wax-soo-saarrada AB iyo BA ee matricesyo aan labajibbaaran ahayn, iyo shuruudaha qeexidda matrix rogan
z-m-31-09.goal: Ku muuji tusaale in xataa haddii AB uu yahay matrix aqoonsi 1×1, BA laga yaabo inaysan ahayn matrix aqoonsi 2×2, oo sharax shuruudaha loo baahan yahay si loogu yeedho rogan.
z-m-31-09.material: A waa matrix 1×2 ( a₁ a₂ ) B-na waa matrix 2×1 ( b₁ ; b₂ ) (saf sare b₁, saf hoose b₂). Wax-soo-saarka AB waa matrix 1×1 ( a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ ), wax-soo-saarka BA-na waa matrix 2×2. Marka AB uu yahay matrix aqoonsi 1×1 ( 1 ), Minjun wuxuu yiri, "AB = ( 1 ), sidaas darteed B waa rogan A." (Xaqiiqada ah in haddii wax-soo-saarka laba matrix oo labajibbaaran uu yahay matrix aqoonsi markaas wax-soo-saarka kala horreynta la beddelay sidoo kale yahay matrix aqoonsi lama isticmaalo hawshan.)

z-m-31-09.thinking.2: Kala saarista xaaladda matricesyada labajibbaaran iyo midda aan ahayn
z-m-31-09.prereq.0: H3 ee hawshan waa adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada qorshahan soo saarista oo keliya, macnaheeduna ma aha in manhajku waxyaabahan fasalkaas u qoondeeyo. Waxaan malaynaynaa inaad ogtahay wax-soo-saarrada matricesyada cabbirro kala duwan leh ((m×n)·(n×k) → m×k) iyo matrix aqoonsiga.

z-m-31-09.s.s1.o.d: In xubnaha A iyo B dhammaantood aysan ahayn eber
z-m-31-09.s.s1.r.d: Shuruudda ah in xubnuhu aysan ahayn eber ma ka muuqato qeexidda rogan.
z-m-31-09.s.s1.explain: Matrix rogan waa matrix leh AB = E iyo BA = E. AB waa 1×1 BA-na waa 2×2, sidaas darteed waa matricesyo cabbirro kala duwan leh, xataa haddii AB = ( 1 ), BA = E waa in si gooni ah loo hubiyaa.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.prompt: Samee saddex xubnood oo tirooyin dhan oo kala duwan (a₁, a₂, b₁, b₂) oo A iyo B ah si AB = ( 1 ) iyo xubinta saf 1, tiir 2 ee BA ay u noqon mid aan ahayn 0.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor dhammaan xubnaha BA adigoo a₁, a₂, b₁, b₂ isticmaalaya.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ka dib doorashada qiyamka buuxiya a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ = 1, hubi haddii xubinta saf 1, tiir 2 ee BA, b₁a₂, aysan ahayn 0.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.var.b1: Xubinta safka sare b₁ ee B
z-m-31-09.s.s2.var.b2: Xubinta safka hoose b₂ ee B
z-m-31-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Xubinta saf 1, tiir 2 ee BA, b₁a₂, ma aha 0.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Xubinta saf 1, tiir 2 ee BA waa 0. Haddii xubintani aysan ahayn 0, BA ma noqon karto matrix aqoonsi.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.explain: BA = ( b₁a₁ b₁a₂ ; b₂a₁ b₂a₂ ). Tusaale ahaan, (1, 1, 2, −1) ahaan, AB = 1×2 + 1×(−1) = 1 iyo BA = ( 2 2 ; −1 −1 ). Xubinta saf 1, tiir 2 waa 2, sidaas darteed ma aha matrix aqoonsi 2×2.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro hal tusaale oo aad samaysay, xisaabi BA, sheeg haddii ay tahay matrix aqoonsi 2×2, oo qor sida gabagabada Minjun loo saxo.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qor afarta xubnood ee BA xarfo oo eeg haddii laba xubnood aysan ahayn eber.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.because.hint.1: Xusuuso kee ka mid ah AB iyo BA ayaa ka maqnaa qeexidda rogan.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma si toos ah u dhufatay xubnaha BA ee aan qoray oo mar kale hubiyay?
z-m-31-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegay shuruudda la lifaaqo si loo saxo gabagabada Minjun?
z-m-31-09.s.s2.because.model.0: Tusaalahayga A = ( 1 1 ), B = ( 2 ; −1 ), BA = ( 2 2 ; −1 −1 ). Ma aha matrix aqoonsi 2×2 (xubinta saf 1, tiir 2 ma aha 0). Sidaas darteed xataa haddii AB = ( 1 ), B ma aha rogan A.
z-m-31-09.s.s2.because.model.1: BA waa cabbir 2×2, sidaas darteed isla markiiba ma odhan karno inay le'eg tahay AB. Marka si toos ah loo dhufto, xubnaha ka baxsan dhidibka ma aha 0, sidaas darteed ma aha E. Sidaas darteed AB = E oo keliya ma na oggolaanayo inaan ugu yeedhno rogan.

z-m-31-10.title: Marka qaab matrix lagu dhaqaajiyo, maxay bedkiisu noqdaa?
z-m-31-10.topic: Bedka qaab ka dib beddelidda matrix iyo qiimaha saafiga ah ee determinant
z-m-31-10.goal: Ku xaqiiji xisaab toos ah iyo naqshad in marka saddex-geesood matrix lagu dhaqaajiyo bedkiisu lagu dhufto qiimaha saafiga ah ee determinant-ka, oo sharax sababta bedku uusan u noqon taban marka determinant-ku yahay taban.
z-m-31-10.material: Dhidibka isku-dubbaridka, u daawo dhibic (x, y) sidii matrix tiir oo ku dhufo matrix 2×2 M = ( a b ; c d ) si loo dhaqaajiyo dhibic cusub ( ax+by , cx+dy ). Geesaha saddex-geesood T waa O(0, 0), P(2, 0), iyo Q(0, 3), bedkiisuna waa 3. Marka T lagu dhaqaajiyo matrix M = ( 1 2 ; 3 4 ), P wuxuu u dhaqaaqaa P′(2, 6), Q wuxuu u dhaqaaqaa Q′(6, 12), O-na wuxuu ku sii jiraa O(0, 0). Determinant-ka M waa 1·4 − 2·3 = −2.
z-m-31-10.thinking.2: Kala saarista waxa calaamaddu macnaheedu yahay iyo waxa aysan macnaheedu ahayn
z-m-31-10.prereq.0: H3 ee hawshan waa adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada qorshahan soo saarista oo keliya, macnaheeduna ma aha in manhajku waxyaabahan fasalkaas u qoondeeyo. Waxaan malaynaynaa inaad ogtahay wax-soo-saarka matrix 2×2 iyo dhibic (matrix tiir), determinant-ka ad−bc, iyo sida loo helo bedka saddex-geesood leh hal geesood asalka ah dhidibka isku-dubbaridka (salka iyo dhererka sare, ama qaacidada isku-dubbaridka).
z-m-31-10.s.s1.prompt: Ka hor inta aadan si toos ah u xisaabin bedka saddex-geesoodka la dhaqaajiyay OP′Q′, samee qiyaas. Kee ayaa ugu suurtagalsan?
z-m-31-10.s.s1.hint.0: Adoo isticmaalaya isku-dubbaridka P′ iyo Q′, hel bedka adigoo isticmaalaya salka ama qaacidada isku-dubbaridka saddex-geesood.
z-m-31-10.s.s1.hint.1: Hel saamiga bedka asalka ah 3 iyo bedka la dhaqaajiyay, oo ku is barbar dhig saamigaas determinant-ka −2.
z-m-31-10.s.s1.o.a: −6. Waa bedka asalka ah 3 oo lagu dhufay determinant-ka −2 sida uu yahay
z-m-31-10.s.s1.r.a: Bed ma noqon karo taban. Mar kale ka fikir macne noocee ah ayuu qiimaha −2 ee determinant-ku ku xiran yahay bedka.
z-m-31-10.s.s1.o.b: 3. Xataa marka matrix lagu dhaqaajiyo, bedka saddex-geesoodku waa sii jiraa isbeddel la'aan
z-m-31-10.s.s1.r.b: Isku-dubbaridka dhibcaha la dhaqaajiyay P′ iyo Q′ aad bay uga fog yihiin kuwii asalka ahaa. Eeg haddii bedku sii jiri karo isku mid.
z-m-31-10.s.s1.o.c: 6. Waa bedka asalka ah 3 oo lagu dhufay cabbirka 2 ee determinant-ka
z-m-31-10.s.s1.o.d: 0. Haddii determinant-ku yahay taban, saddex-geesoodku wuu laabmayaa oo fidsan yahay
z-m-31-10.s.s1.r.d: Determinant taban iyo 0 waa wax kala duwan. Hubi haddii saddexda geesood ay ku yaalaan xariiq toosan.
z-m-31-10.s.s1.explain: Xisaabinta runtii, bedka OP′Q′ waa ½|2·12 − 6·6| = 6. Waa 2 jeer bedkii asalka ahaa ee 3, taasoo ah qiimaha saafiga ah ee determinant-ka −2 jeer. Bed ma noqon karo taban, sidaas darteed cabbirka calaamad la'aanta waa isugeynta weyneynta.
z-m-31-10.s.s2.prompt: Marka isla saddex-geesood T lagu dhaqaajiyo matrix M = ( a b ; c d ), samee saddex xubnood oo tirooyin dhan oo kala duwan (a, b, c, d) oo bedka saddex-geesoodka cusub uu yahay 12. Geesaha la dhaqaajiyay waa P′(2a, 2c) iyo Q′(3b, 3d).
z-m-31-10.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor tibaax bedka saddex-geesoodka cusub ee a, b, c, d ahaan.
z-m-31-10.s.s2.hint.1: Hel qiimaha ad − bc ay tahay inay noqoto si tibaaxdaasi u noqoto 12, oo dooro a, b, c, d ka dhigaya qiimahaas.
z-m-31-10.s.s2.var.a: Xubinta koowaad ee safka sare a ee M
z-m-31-10.s.s2.var.b: Xubinta labaad ee safka sare b ee M
z-m-31-10.s.s2.var.c: Xubinta koowaad ee safka hoose c ee M
z-m-31-10.s.s2.var.d: Xubinta labaad ee safka hoose d ee M
z-m-31-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Bedka saddex-geesoodka la dhaqaajiyay ma aha 12. Mar kale xisaabi bedka adigoo isku-dubbaridka P′(2a, 2c) iyo Q′(3b, 3d) isticmaalaya.
z-m-31-10.s.s2.explain: Bedka saddex-geesoodka cusub waa ½|2a·3d − 3b·2c| = 3|ad − bc|. Si ay u noqoto 12, |ad − bc| = 4, taasi waa determinant-ku waa inuu noqdaa 4 ama −4. Tusaale ahaan, (2, 0, 0, 2) wuxuu leeyahay determinant 4 (2, 0, 0, −2)-na wuxuu leeyahay determinant −4, laakiin labaduba waxay leeyihiin bed 12.
z-m-31-10.s.s3.prompt: Adoo arkaya in beddelid leh determinant −4 iyo mid leh 4 labaduba ay bixiyaan bed 12, qor xiriirka u dhexeeya determinant-ka iyo bedka hal ama laba weedhood. Haddii aadan weli ogeyn macnaha calaamadda, waad qori kartaa inaadan ogeyn oo qor waxa aad indha-indheysay.
z-m-31-10.s.s3.hint.0: Qor isbarbar bedka cusub xaaladda determinant 4 iyo xaaladda −4.
z-m-31-10.s.s3.hint.1: Hel saamiga bedka asalka ah iyo bedka cusub oo is barbar dhig determinant-ka.
z-m-31-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Xiriirka aan qoray ma sax yahay labada xaaladood (determinant 4 iyo −4)?
z-m-31-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay si gooni ah waxa aan ogahay iyo waxa aanan ogeyn ee ku saabsan macnaha calaamadda?
z-m-31-10.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma hubiyay saamiga bedka asalka ah 3 iyo bedka cusub 12 lambarro?
z-m-31-10.s.s3.model.0: Bedku wuxuu noqdaa |determinant| jeer kii asalka ahaa. Determinant-ku 4 ama −4, wuxuu ka tagaa 3 ilaa 12, sidaas darteed waa 4 jeer. Calaamaddu waxay u muuqataa mid aan la xiriirin bedka laakiin wax kale, sida haddii qaabku rogmado.
z-m-31-10.s.s3.model.1: Wuxuu ka tegay 3 ilaa 12, sidaas darteed waa 4 jeer, tanina waxay le'eg tahay qiimaha saafiga ah ee determinant-ka. Calaamadda kala duwan ma lahayn saameyn bedka. Weli runtii ma ogi macnaha calaamadda.

z-m-31-07.title: AB = AC, ma odhan karnaa B = C?
z-m-31-07.topic: Shuruudaha iyo tusaalayaasha ka soo horjeedda ee baabi'inta isla matrix-ka isku-dhufashada matrix-yada
z-m-31-07.goal: Ka xukun shuruudaha hoostooda sababaynta 'baabi'inaysa' A labada dhinac AB = AC si loo helo B = C ay tahay mid xaq ah, oo dhis tusaale ka soo horjeedda kiiska shuruudda aan jirin.
z-m-31-07.material: Matrix-yada 2×2 A, B, iyo C, AB = AC wuu sii jiraa. Hyeonmin sidan ayuu u xaliyay. "Haddii aad ka baabi'iso A labada dhinac, B = C. Waa la mid sida tirooyinka, haddii ab = ac markaas b = c."
z-m-31-07.thinking.0: Hubinta shuruudaha marka xeer tirooyinka ah loo gudbiyo matrix-yada
z-m-31-07.thinking.1: Doorashada macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si loo gaaro gabagabo
z-m-31-07.thinking.2: Naqshadaynta tusaale ka soo horjeedda adigu oo sharaxaadda sababta
z-m-31-07.prereq.0: H3 ee hawshan waa adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada qorshahan soo saarka ah oo keliya, mana ay macnaheedu yahay in manhajku nuxurkan u qoondeeyo fasalkaas. Waxaan u qaadanaynaa inaad taqaan isku-dhufashada matrix-yada 2×2, matrix-ka aqoonsiga, iyo matrix-yada beddelaadka (jira marka ad−bc≠0).
z-m-31-07.prereq.1: Waad ogtahay in sharciga is-beddelka guud ahaan aanu jirin isku-dhufashada matrix-yada.
z-m-31-07.s.s1.prompt: Sidee ayaad u qiimeyn doontaa 'ka baabi'i A labada dhinac' ee Hyeonmin?
z-m-31-07.s.s1.hint.0: Hal weedh ku sheeg sababta, tirooyinka, ab = ac ay u siinayso b = c.
z-m-31-07.s.s1.hint.1: Qor haddii isla sababtu ay u shaqeyso matrix A, iyo sifada A ee loo baahan yahay.
z-m-31-07.s.s1.o.a: Waa sax. Matrix-yadu waa sida tirooyinka, sidaas darteed labada dhinac waad ku qaybin kartaa isla matrix A
z-m-31-07.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u aragtay isku-dhufashada matrix-yada sida isku-dhufashada tirooyinka. Ma hubin haddii aad ku qaybin karto matrix A kasta.
z-m-31-07.s.s1.o.b: Shuruud la'aan ma xaq ah, waana in aan eegno A kee ayuu u shaqeynayaa
z-m-31-07.s.s1.o.c: Had iyo jeer waa khalad. Suurtagal ma aha AB = AC inuu sii jiro B = C
z-m-31-07.s.s1.r.c: Haddii B iyo C ay yihiin isla matrix, AB = AC dabiici ahaan wuu sii jiraa. 'Had iyo jeer khalad' waa odhaah xad dhaaf ah.
z-m-31-07.s.s1.o.d: Inta A aysan ahayn matrix-ka eber, ka baabi'inta A labada dhinac waa sax
z-m-31-07.s.s1.r.d: Ma baarin haddii aan ahayn matrix-ka eber ay ku filan tahay. Raadi kiisaska isku-dhufashooyinku isku mid yihiin laakiin labada matrix ay kala duwan yihiin.
z-m-31-07.s.s1.explain: Tirooyinka, haddii ab = ac iyo a ≠ 0 markaas b = c sababtoo ah waxaan ku qaybin karnaa a. Matrix-yada, 'qaybinta' macnaheedu waa ku dhufashada beddelaadka A, tanna waxaa la samayn karaa marka A leeyahay beddelaad oo keliya. Hubinta A kee ayuu u shaqeynayaa ayaa ugu horreysa.
z-m-31-07.s.s2.prompt: Si gabagabada B = C looga helo AB = AC, dooro macluumaadka sax ah ee aan u baahanahay inaan wax badan ka ogaano A.
z-m-31-07.s.s2.hint.0: U kala qaybi kiiska A uu leeyahay beddelaad iyo kiiska aanu lahayn, oo ka fikir haddii B = C laga heli karo labada kiis.
z-m-31-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ku tijaabi hal tusaale gaar ah haddii sifooyinka A ay beddelmaan macluumaadka B iyo C (ma aha matrix-yada eber, leh beddelaad).
z-m-31-07.s.s2.o.a: Inaan gelitaannada A dhammaantood ahayn 0 (A ma aha matrix-ka eber)
z-m-31-07.s.s2.r.a: A = ( 1 2 ; 2 4 ) ma aha matrix-ka eber, laakiin B = ( 1 3 ; 1 0 ) iyo C = ( 1 1 ; 1 1 ), AB = AC oo B ≠ C waa suurtagal.
z-m-31-07.s.s2.o.b: Xaqiiqada ah B iyo C labaduba leeyihiin beddelaad
z-m-31-07.s.s2.r.b: Haddii B = E, C = ( −1 0 ; 1 1 ) (labaduba go'aamiye aan eber ahayn leh) iyo A = ( 1 2 ; 2 4 ), markaas AB = AC = A laakiin B ≠ C. Xitaa haddii B iyo C ay leeyihiin beddelaad, taasi macnaheedu ma aha inaad baabi'in karto.
z-m-31-07.s.s2.o.c: Xaqiiqada ah A, B, iyo C dhammaantood waa matrix-yo 2×2 oo isku cabbir ah
z-m-31-07.s.s2.r.c: Waa shuruudda ah cabbirradu inay is waafaqaan si isku-dhufashadu u jiro oo keliya, wax kuma lahan inaad baabi'in karto iyo in kale. Dhibaatadan, A, B, iyo C horay ayay dhammaantood u ahaayeen 2×2.
z-m-31-07.s.s2.o.d: Inuu A leeyahay beddelaad (go'aamiyuhu ma aha 0)
z-m-31-07.s.s2.explain: Haddii A leeyahay beddelaad, ku dhufashada A⁻¹ bidixda labada dhinac ee AB = AC waxay siinaysaa B = C. Haddii aanu lahayn beddelaad, tusaale ka soo horjeedda ayaa soo bixi kara. Sidaas darteed macluumaadka loo baahan yahay ma aha sifo B iyo C laakiin waa beddelaadka A.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.prompt: Ha ahaato A = ( 1 2 ; 2 4 ) iyo C = ( 1 1 ; 1 1 ). Kadib hel saddex (p, q) oo kala duwan oo B = ( 1 p ; 1 q ) uu buuxiyo AB = AC B-na uu leeyahay beddelaad.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qor natiijada ( p + 2q , 2p + 4q ) ee ku dhufashada A tiirka labaad (p, q) ee B, oo hel shuruudda ay la mid noqoto natiijada ku dhufashada A tiirka labaad (1, 1) ee C.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.hint.1: Dooro hal (p, q) oo buuxinaya shuruudda, qor B, oo si toos ah u dhufo AB iyo AC si aad u hubiso in labada matrix ay isku mid yihiin.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.var.p: Gelitaanka labaad ee safka sare p ee B
z-m-31-07.s.s3.var.q: Gelitaanka labaad ee safka hoose q ee B
z-m-31-07.s.s3.ok.c1: AB = AC wuu sii jiraa (tiirarka labaad waxay ku dhufmaan isla natiijo).
z-m-31-07.s.s3.fail.c1: AB iyo AC isku mid ma aha. Natiijada ku dhufashada A tiirka labaad (p, q) ee B waa inay la mid noqotaa natiijada (3, 6) ee ku dhufashada A tiirka labaad (1, 1) ee C.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.ok.c2: Go'aamiyaha B, q − p, ma aha 0, sidaas darteed B wuxuu leeyahay beddelaad.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.fail.c2: Go'aamiyaha B, q − p, waa 0. Markaas B wuxuu noqonayaa la mid C.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.explain: A·(tiirka labaad (p, q)) = ( p + 2q , 2p + 4q ), si ay u noqoto la mid A·(1, 1) = (3, 6), waxaa ku filan p + 2q = 3. Go'aamiyaha B waa q − p, (p, q) = (1, 1) oo keliya ayaa leh q = p, sidaas darteed xal kasta oo kale B wuu ka duwan yahay C oo sidoo kale wuxuu leeyahay beddelaad. Sidaas darteed AB = AC laakiin B ≠ C.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.because.prompt: Hal ama laba weedh ku sharax sifada A ee suurtagal ka dhigaysa B iyo C sidaas.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.because.hint.0: Qor xidhiidhka u dhexeeya labada gelitaan ee soo baxa marka A lagu dhufto tiirka labaad ee B.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.because.hint.1: Qor xidhiidhka u dhexeeya safka sare iyo safka hoose ee A.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Sharaxaaddaydu ma ka hadlaysaa sifooyinka A halkii ay ka hadli lahayd kuwa B iyo C?
z-m-31-07.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegay sida go'aamiyaha oo ah 0 u xidhan yahay labada saf oo isku saamayn ah?
z-m-31-07.s.s3.because.model.0: Waa sababtoo ah go'aamiyaha A waa 1·4 − 2·2 = 0, sidaas darteed ma laha beddelaad. Sidaas darteed marka lagu dhufto A, laba tiir oo kala duwan waxay bixin karaan isla natiijo.
z-m-31-07.s.s3.because.model.1: Safka hoose ee A waa 2 jeer safka sare, sidaas darteed xitaa haddii A lagu dhufto tiirar kala duwan, isla natiijo ayaa soo bixi karta. Beddelaad ma jiro, sidaas darteed ma baabi'in karno labada dhinac.

z-m-31-08.title: Intee in le'eg ayuu isgoyska laba xariiq oo isku-dhufashooyinkoodu yihiin ku dhawaad isku mid u gariiraa?
z-m-31-08.topic: Isle'egyada toosan ee isku wada socda, go'aamiyayaasha, iyo matrix-yada beddelaadka (saamaynta khaladka cabbirka ee xalka)
z-m-31-08.goal: Natiijooyinka xisaabta ku hubi in nidaamka isle'egyada go'aamiyihiisu u dhow yahay 0, khalad yar oo qiimayaasha dhinaca midig ah uu si weyn u gariirin karo xalka, oo sharax sababta adigoo ku xidhaya matrix-ka beddelaadka.
z-m-31-08.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno halka xariiqaha dhexe ee laba waddo oo toosan ay ku kulmaan khariidad. Cutubka isku-duwayaasha waa km. Isle'egyada labada xariiq ee cabbirka laga helay waa x + y = 2 iyo x + 1.01y = 2.03. Qiimaha dhinaca midig 2.03 waxaa lagu kor rogay meesha tobanlaha labaad, sidaas darteed runtii wuxuu ka fogaan karaa ugu badnaan 0.005. U qaado isku-dhufashooyinka bidix inay sax yihiin. Xalka (isgoyska) nidaamkan waa (x, y) = (−1, 3).

z-m-31-08.thinking.2: Kala saarista in xitaa haddii go'aamiyuhu aanu ahayn 0, xasiloonida xalka ay kala duwanaan karto

z-m-31-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Sabab u ah farqiga ma jirto; waa kadis
z-m-31-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ma eegin xaqiiqada ah matrix-yada isku-dhufashooyinka ee labada nidaam ay kala duwan yihiin.
z-m-31-08.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Nidaamka ugu horreeya labada xariiq ku dhawaad way isku xigaan, sidaas darteed isgoysku aad ayuu u dhaqaaqaa
z-m-31-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Go'aamiyayaasha matrix-yada isku-dhufashooyinka waa 0.01 ee kan ugu horreeya iyo −2 ee kan labaad. Matrix-yada beddelaadka waa ( 101 −100 ; −100 100 ) iyo ( 0.5 0.5 ; 0.5 −0.5 ) siday u kala horreeyaan.
z-m-31-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Maxaad ka odhan kartaa macluumaadkan ku saabsan 'matrix isku-dhufashooyin go'aamiyihiisu u dhow yahay 0'?

Xitaa haddii go'aamiyuhu aanu ahayn 0, haddii uu u dhow yahay 0, xalku wuu xasilloonaan karaa.
z-m-31-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Inta go'aamiyuhu aanu ahayn 0, khaladka qiimayaasha dhinaca midig wuxuu xalka ugu gudbaa cabbir la mid ah
z-m-31-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad tidhi labaduba isku mid yihiin xitaa kadib aragtida laba kiis oo cabbirrada gelitaannada beddelaadku aad u kala duwan yihiin.

z-m-31-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Labada kiis, gariirka xalku wuu kala duwanaa marka go'aamiyuhu ahaa 0.01 iyo −2. Cabbirka go'aamiyaha iyo gelitaannada beddelaadku way xidhiidhsan yihiin.
z-m-31-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Haddii go'aamiyuhu u dhow yahay 0, gelitaannada beddelaadku way weynaadaan oo khalad yar ayaa la kordhin karaa
z-m-31-08.s.s1.reflect: Tallaabadii ugu horreysay, ma filaysay khaladku inuu 'si toos ah' u gudbo? Sidee ayaad filashadaas u beddeshay kadib aragtida macluumaadkii u dambeeyay? Ma 'go'aamiyuhu ma aha 0, sidaas darteed waxaa jira hal xal oo keliya' waa la mid 'xalku waa la aamini karaa'?
z-m-31-08.s.s2.prompt: Dooro dhammaan hababka caawiya yaraynta hubanti la'aanta xalka nidaamka go'aamiyihiisu u dhow yahay 0.
z-m-31-08.s.s2.hint.0: Habka kasta, si gooni ah u qor midka 'khaladka qiimayaasha dhinaca midig,' 'matrix-ka isku-dhufashooyinka,' ama 'habka xisaabinta xalka' ee uu beddelo.
z-m-31-08.s.s2.hint.1: Si toos ah u hubi haddii xalka (x, y) uu beddelmo marka labada dhinac lagu dhufto 100.
z-m-31-08.s.s2.o.a: Si sax ah u cabbir qiimayaasha dhinaca midig ee isla labada isle'eg, afar meel oo tobanle ah

z-m-31-08.s.s2.o.c: Dooro shuruudo cabbir cusub si dhaadhacyada labada xariiq ay si cad u kala duwanaadaan
z-m-31-08.s.s2.r.c: Tani waa hab ka durugsada determinant-ka 0 oo yareeya weyneynta ay keento matrix-ka rogan.

z-m-31-08.s.s2.r.d: Magacyada oo keliya ayaa isbeddelaya, habaynta xariiqyadu waa sii jirtaa.
z-m-31-08.s.s2.o.e: Mar kale u wareeji qiimaha midig ee horey loo wareegay laba meelood oo jajab ah oo isticmaal
z-m-31-08.s.s2.r.e: Dib u wareejinta qiime horey loo wareegay ma abuurto macluumaad cusub, sidaas darteed khaladka qiimaha midigtu sidiisa ayuu sii jiraa.
z-m-31-08.s.s2.explain: Yaraynta khaladka qiyamka midigta (a) iyo beddelidda shuruudaha cabbirka si determinant-ka matrix-ka isugeynta uu uga durugo 0 (c) waxay yareeyaan hubanti la'aanta xalka. Ku dhufashada labada dhinac isla lambar (b), magac-bixinta (d), ama dib u wareejinta qiime horey loo wareegay (e) runtii ma beddeli karaan khaladka ama habaynta xariiqyada.

z-m-31-11.title: Ma hal sadar oo isla'eg ah ayaa dammaanad qaadaya jiritaanka matrix rogan?
z-m-31-11.topic: Go'aaminta jiritaanka matrix rogan xiriir ku saabsan matrix
z-m-31-11.goal: Xiriirrada A buuxiyo, kala saar xaaladaha aad hubaal ka ogaan karto A inuu leeyahay rogan iyo kuwa aadan ogaan karin, oo hel sadarka khaldan ee doodda ka bilaabata malo-awaal oo ku sax tusaale lid ku ah.
z-m-31-11.material: A waa matrix 2×2, E waa matrix aqoonsi, O-na waa matrix eber. Aan eegno afarta xiriir ee soo socda: (가) A² − 3A + 2E = O, (나) A² − 3A = O, (다) A² + E = O, (라) A² = O. Waxaan rabnaa inaan ogaanno haddii aan odhan karno A buuxiya mid kasta 'hubaal ahaan wuxuu leeyahay rogan.'
z-m-31-11.thinking.0: Kala saarista jihada shuruudaha loo baahan yahay iyo kuwa ku filan
z-m-31-11.thinking.1: Muujinta jiritaanka adigoo si toos ah u dhisaya matrix rogan
z-m-31-11.thinking.2: Helidda sadarka doodda halka gabagabada loo celiyo malo-awaalka
z-m-31-11.prereq.0: H3 ee hawshan waa adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada qorshahan soo saarista oo keliya, macnaheeduna ma aha in manhajku waxyaabahan fasalkaas u qoondeeyo. Waxaan malaynaynaa inaad ogtahay wax-soo-saarrada matricesyada labajibbaaran 2×2, matrix aqoonsiga E iyo matrix eber O, iyo qeexidda matrix rogan (B leh AB = BA = E).
z-m-31-11.prereq.1: Waad ogtahay in sharciga qaybinta iyo sharciga isku-xirka ay ku sax yihiin wax-soo-saarrada matrix.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan xiriirrada aad ka odhan karto A kasta oo buuxiya inay hubaal leeyihiin rogan.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.hint.0: Isku day inaad aragto haddii xiriir kasta loo beddeli karo qaabka 'ku dhufashada A matrix oo kale waxay bixisaa E.'
z-m-31-11.s.s1.hint.1: Xiriir adag in lagu sheego jiritaanka rogan, hel hal A gaar ah oo buuxiya xiriirka oo hubi.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.r.a: A = O wuxuu buuxiyaa xiriirkan, laakiin matrix eber rogan ma laha. Ma odhan karno hubaal ahaan wuxuu leeyahay rogan.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.r.c: Haddii A² uu yahay matrix eber A-na uu leeyahay rogan, ku dhufashada labada dhinac A⁻¹ waxay bixisaa A = O, taasoo is-diid la leh haysashada rogan. A buuxiya xiriirkan ma yeelan karo rogan.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.explain: (가) waa A(A − 3E) = −2E, sidaas darteed A·(−½(A − 3E)) = E, taasoo macnaheedu yahay wuxuu leeyahay rogan −½(A − 3E). (다) waa A·(−A) = E, sidaas darteed waxaa jira rogan −A. (나) waxay leedahay tusaalayaal lid ku ah sida A = O, (라) na halkii waa xaalad aan yeelan karin rogan.
z-m-31-11.s.s2.prompt: Arday ayaa qoray dood isku dayaysa inuu muujiyo A buuxiya (나) A² − 3A = O hubaal ahaan wuxuu leeyahay rogan. Dooro sadarka ugu horreeya ee khaldan.
z-m-31-11.s.s2.hint.0: Calaamadee in sadarka 2 uu ku bilowdo 'haddii A uu leeyahay rogan.'
z-m-31-11.s.s2.hint.1: Is barbar dhig haddii xadka sadarka 4 ka hadlayo ('dhammaan') uu yahay isla xadka sadarrada 2 iyo 3 muujiyeen.
z-m-31-11.s.s2.line.0: Soo saarista A dhinaca bidix ee A² − 3A = O waxay bixisaa A(A − 3E) = O.
z-m-31-11.s.s2.line.1: Haddii A uu leeyahay rogan, ku dhufashada roganka dhinaca bidix ee labada dhinac waxay bixisaa A − 3E = O.
z-m-31-11.s.s2.line.3: A = 3E waa matrix leh rogan, sidaas darteed A kasta oo buuxiya isla'egta asalka ah wuxuu leeyahay rogan.
z-m-31-11.s.s2.line.4: Sidaas darteed A buuxiya (나) hubaal ahaan wuxuu leeyahay rogan.
z-m-31-11.s.s2.explain: Sadarka 4 waa khalad. Sadarrada 2 iyo 3 waxay yidhaahdaan 'haddii aan u qaadno inuu leeyahay rogan, A waa 3E oo keliya,' ma aha 'A kasta oo buuxiya isla'egta waa 3E.' Ma sharaxi kartid dhammaan xaaladaha natiijo laga helay malo-awaal. Runtii A = O wuxuu buuxiyaa isla'egta, laakiin ma aha 3E mana laha rogan.
z-m-31-11.s.s3.prompt: Sii hal matrix oo tusaale lid ku ah oo muujinaya (나) in aysan had iyo jeer sax ahayn. Wada qor in matrix-ku buuxiyo isla'egta iyo in uusan lahayn rogan.
z-m-31-11.s.s3.hint.0: Geli matrix fudud (mid inta badan xubnaheeda ay yihiin 0) isla'egta A² − 3A = O.
z-m-31-11.s.s3.hint.1: Hel determinant-ka matrix-kaas oo hubi inuusan ahayn 0.
z-m-31-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma si toos ah u gelisay matrix-ka aan bixiyay tibaaxda A² − 3A oo xisaabiyay haddii uu noqdo O?
z-m-31-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma bixiyay sababta uusan u lahayn rogan (determinant-ku waa 0, ama waa matrix eber)?
z-m-31-11.s.s3.model.0: (나) waa khalad. Haddii A uu yahay matrix eber, A² − 3A = O, laakiin matrix eber rogan ma laha.
z-m-31-11.s.s3.model.1: Haddii A = ( 3 0 ; 0 0 ), markaas A² = ( 9 0 ; 0 0 ) = 3A, sidaas darteed wuxuu buuxiyaa isla'egta. Laakiin determinant-kiisu waa 0, sidaas darteed rogan ma jiro.

z-m-31-13.title: Laba xeer oo kala-soocayaasha ah kee ayaan aamini karnaa?
z-m-31-13.topic: Qiyaasaha iyo hubinta kala-soocaha wax-soo-saarka det(AB) iyo wadarka det(A+B)
z-m-31-13.goal: Khibrad ku saabsan hal ama laba tusaale oo ka dhigaya mid adag in xeerarka la kala sooco, xukun kala duwanaanshaha xeerku run ku yahay adigoo tusaalayaal lid ku ah iyo fidinta xarfaha isticmaalaya, oo naftaada samee xaalado kadis ku run ah.
z-m-31-13.material: Matrix-yo 2×2 A iyo B, waxaa jira laba xeer oo musharrax ah. (R1) det(AB) = det(A)·det(B), (R2) det(A+B) = det(A) + det(B). Halkan det waa kala-soocaha. Waxaan rabnaa inaan ogaano xeerka kee ayaa had iyo jeer run ah.
z-m-31-13.thinking.1: Diidmada xeer adigoo tusaale lid ku ah isticmaalaya
z-m-31-13.thinking.2: Kala saaridda caddayn guud (fidinta xarfaha) iyo tusaalayaal
z-m-31-13.prereq.0: H3 ee hawshani waa adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada qorshahan wax-soo-saarka oo keliya, macnaheedu na maaha in manhajku nuxurkan ku meelaynayo sannad gaar ah. Waxaan u malaynaynaa inaad taqaan wax-soo-saarka iyo wadarka matrix-yada 2×2 iyo kala-soocaha ad−bc.
z-m-31-13.prereq.1: Waad fidin kartaa tibaaxaha ka kooban xarfo.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.prompt: Xogta hal-hal ayaa loo muujiyaa. Mar kasta, dooro xukunkaaga ku saabsan R1 iyo R2.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.hint.0: Labada xeer mid walba, shax ku habee imisa tusaale ayaa ilaa hadda run ku ahaa iyo imisa ayaa fashilmay.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.hint.1: Si gooni ah u qor xeerka leh tusaale fashilmay iyo xeerka aan lahayn, oo ku qor heerka kalsoonida mid walba hal erey.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.info: A = ( 1 0 ; 0 1 ) iyo B = ( 1 2 ; 3 −1 ), det(AB) = −7 = 1·(−7) iyo det(A+B) = −6 = 1 + (−7). Labada xeer labaduba waxay run ku ahaayeen tusaalahan.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.ask: Sidee u xukumi doontaa R1 iyo R2 lammaanahan keliya?
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.after: Sababtoo ah shuruudaha gaarka ah ee A uu yahay matrix-ka aqoonsiga iyo raadka B uu yahay 0, labada xeer kadis ayay run u ahaadeen. Tusaalahan labada xeer ma kala saari karo.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Labada xeer labaduba waxay run yihiin dhammaan lammaanayaasha matrix-yada
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Hal tusaale oo sax ah macnaheedu maaha dhammaan xaaladaha sax yihiin. Waxaa jira laba xeer oo siinaya isla natiijo, sidaa darteed lama kala saari karo.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Tusaalahan oo keliya ma kala saari karo, lammaanayaal kale sidoo kale waa in la tijaabiyaa
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.o.c: R1 wuxuu u egyahay mid macquul ah, sidaa darteed u qaad R1 run yahay oo ha sii tijaabin
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kani waa xukun dareen ku salaysan. Tusaalahani labada xeer ma kala saaro.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hal tusaale ayaa run ahaa, sidaa darteed caddaynta dhammaan xaaladaha way dhammaatay
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hal tusaale oo run ahaada maaha caddayn. Waa inaad sii tijaabisaa si aad u aragto haddii uu jiro tusaale lid ku ah.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.info: A = ( 2 1 ; 0 3 ) iyo B = ( 1 0 ; 4 2 ), det A = 6, det B = 2, det(AB) = 12 = 6·2. Laakiin det(A+B) = 11 iyo det A + det B = 8.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sidee u beddeli doontaa xukunkaaga ku saabsan R1 iyo R2 hadda?
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.after: R2 waxaa la diiday hal lammaane tusaale lid ku ah. R1 wuxuu run ahaa laba lammaane, sidaa darteed rumaysadku wuu kordhaa, laakiin dhammaan lammaanayaasha weli lama hubin.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.o.a: R2 wuxuu bixiyaa tusaale lid ku ah, sidaa darteed diid. R1 hadda waa ka rumaysnaan badan yahay, laakiin weli lama go'aamin
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 11 iyo 8 waa isku dhow yihiin, sidaa darteed R2 waa xeer ku dhow sax
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.r.b: 'Ku dhow isle'eg' ma aha isle'eg. Xeer had iyo jeer run ahi waa inuusan fashilmin xataa hal lammaane.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.o.c: R1 iyo R2 labaduba waa khalad. Hal mar sax iyo hal mar khalad, midna xeer ma aha
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.r.c: R1 wuxuu run ahaa tusaalahan sidoo kale. R2 oo keliya ayaa fashilmay.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.o.d: R2 wuxuu run ahaa tusaalihii koowaad, sidaa darteed iska indho-tir tusaalaha lid ku ah oo sidii ay ahayd ilaali
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hal tusaale oo lid ku ah ayaa jebiya 'had iyo jeer.' Tusaalihii koowaad oo run ahaa waxaa laga yaabaa inay ahayd shuruudo gaar ah awgeed.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.info: Ha noqdo A = ( a b ; c d ) iyo B = ( e f ; g h ) oo fidi, det(AB) = (ae+bg)(cf+dh) − (af+bh)(ce+dg) wuxuu u fududaadaa (ad−bc)(eh−fg) (fidintii waa la hubiyey). Sidoo kale det(A+B) − det A − det B = ah + de − bg − cf.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.ask: Heerkee ayaad hadda ku kalsoonaan kartaa R1?
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.after: Fidinta xarfuhu waxay xaqiijisaa in R1 uu run yahay dhammaan lammaanayaasha 2×2. Laakiin xaqiijintan waxay ku xaddidan tahay 2×2, 3×3 ama ka weyn na si gooni ah ayaa loo eegaa. R2 wuxuu run yahay marka ah + de − bg − cf = 0 oo keliya.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Waxaa lagu xaqiijiyey fidinta xarfaha, ma aha dhowr tusaale, in uu run yahay dhammaan lammaanayaasha matrix-yada 2×2, sidaa darteed waxaan odhan karnaa had iyo jeer wuu run yahay matrix-yada 2×2
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Xataa fidinta xarfaha ma go'aamin karto. Waa inaan tijaabinno tiro kasta oo suurtagal ah mid-mid
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Fidinta xarfaha waxay wada maamushaa dhammaan xaaladaha tirooyinka. Looma baahna in mid-mid la tijaabiyo.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Xataa haddii fidintu sax tahay, fidintan oo keliya ma sheegi karto haddii uu run yahay ilaa matrix-yada 3×3. 2×2 wuu run yahay
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.o.d: R2 sidoo kale had iyo jeer wuu run yahay haddii loo fidiyo xarfo
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Fidintu waxay siinaysaa det(A+B) − det A − det B oo la simanyahay ah + de − bg − cf, sidaa darteed R2 wuxuu run yahay marka qiimahan uu yahay 0 oo keliya. Had iyo jeer ma aha 0.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.reflect: Xukunkee ayaad gaartay ka dib aragtida tusaalihii koowaad, oo sidee ayuu xukunkaagu u beddelmay ka dib aragtida tusaalaha lid ku ah iyo ka dib aragtida fidinta xarfaha? Xataa isla 'dhowr tusaale', waa maxay farqiga u dhexeeya xaaladaha aan xeer go'aamin karin iyo xaaladaha rumaysadku kordho?
z-m-31-13.s.s2.prompt: Marka A uu yahay matrix-ka aqoonsiga E, samee saddex B = ( e f ; g h ) oo kala duwan oo R2 (det(E+B) = det E + det B) uu kadis ugu run yahay (marka laga reebo matrix-ka eber).
z-m-31-13.s.s2.hint.0: Fidi det(E+B) adigoo isticmaalaya e, f, g, h, la barbar dhig 1 + det B, oo hel qaybta ay ku kala duwan yihiin.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.hint.1: Xalli xiriirkee ayaa u dhexeeya e iyo h loo baahan yahay si qaybtaasi u noqoto 0, oo samee B waafaqsan xiriirkaas.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.var.e: Gelitaanka koowaad ee safka sare ee B e
z-m-31-13.s.s2.var.f: Gelitaanka labaad ee safka sare ee B f
z-m-31-13.s.s2.var.g: Gelitaanka koowaad ee safka hoose ee B g
z-m-31-13.s.s2.var.h: Gelitaanka labaad ee safka hoose ee B h
z-m-31-13.s.s2.fail.c1: B waa matrix-ka eber. Fadlan samee B aan ahayn matrix-ka eber.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.fail.c2: B-gan, det(E+B) wuu ka duwan yahay 1 + det B. Fidi labada tibaax oo hel xiriirka u dhexeeya e iyo h.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.explain: det(E+B) = (1+e)(1+h) − fg = 1 + e + h + eh − fg, 1 + det B = 1 + eh − fg na, sidaa darteed si labada qiime ay isle'eg u noqdaan, e + h = 0. Taasi waa, R2 wuxuu run yahay marka raadka B uu yahay 0 oo keliya.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.prompt: Qor waxa B-yada aad heshay ay wadaagaan (xiriirka gelitaannada), oo ku dar hal weedh waxa ku dhaca R2 B aan ilaalin xiriirkaas.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.hint.0: Dhinac dhinac u qor e iyo h ee B-yada aad heshay oo hel wadarka labada tiro.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.hint.1: B hal ah oo e + h aan ahayn 0, si toos ah u xisaabi labada qiime oo isbarbar dhig.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma isla xiriirka wuxuu run yahay dhammaan B-yada aan helay?
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma doortay hal B halka xiriirku jabo oo aan hubiyey in labada qiime ay runtii kala duwan yihiin?
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.model.0: B-yada aan helay dhammaantood waxay leeyihiin e + h = 0 (wadarka gelitaannada bidixda sare iyo midigta hoose waa 0). Xiriirkan la'aantiis, tusaale ahaan ( 1 2 ; 3 1 ), det(E+B) = −2 laakiin 1 + det B = −4, sidaa darteed R2 run ma aha.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.model.1: Saddexda B oo dhan, gelitaannada ku-yaal xagal-xariijinta (bidixda sare, midigta hoose) isku darkoodu wuxuu ahaa 0. Marka aan jebiyey shuruuddaas, R2 ma run ahayn.
